E.g. used for PHYs with a compliant to OA TC10. Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value None Description Indicates an wake - up request for the specified Ethernet Transceiver. The given Trcv Specification of Ethernet Transceiver Driver AUTOSAR CP R20 - 11 61 of 89 Document ID 431 : AUTOSAR_SWS_EthernetTransceiverDriver Mode indicates if the request is based on a remote request from the network (ETH_ MODE_ ACTIVE) or if the request is based on active user request (ETH_ MODE_ ACTIVE_ WITH_ WAKEUP_ REQUEST). The callback function Ccan be used to trigger integrator code that initiates a remote wake - up .(e.g. trigger a wake - up line for an active user request).
